**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 of the Silverline MSA already delivers our preferred warranty position in full:

| Playbook element | Document |
|---|---|
| Professional and workmanlike services | § 19.1 — plus qualified personnel and industry standards |
| Conformance to documentation | § 19.1 and § 19.2 (material conformity) |
| Duration | § 19.2 — 90 days for Deliverables running from delivery **or acceptance, whichever is later**; Hosted Services conform **throughout the subscription term** |
| Repair / replace / refund remedy | § 19.4 — re-perform, repair or replace, with termination-and-refund backstop |
| Compliance with laws; no malicious code | § 19.3 — plus no functionality diminishment and open-source protections |
| Disclaimer must not swallow express warranty | § 19.5 — disclaimer limited to implied warranties, mutual, with express carve-out |

Two points worth noting as favorable to us beyond the baseline: the Deliverable warranty clock starts at the *later* of delivery or acceptance rather than delivery alone, and the hosted scope is warranted for the entire subscription term rather than a fixed window. The "sole remedy" narrowing the planner flagged as a risk is absent — § 19.4 affirmatively states the remedy is non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, and indemnified claims, which dovetails with the Excluded Claims carve-outs in § 21.3.

I also confirmed there is no competing disclaimer elsewhere: searches for "AS IS" and "sole remedy" returned no hits, and §§ 3.1 and 6 (acceptance, with correction cycles and refund rights) reinforce rather than undercut the warranty.
